brand_notes.materials: The brand-level `fabric` field in brands.json says 'TPU laminate (shiny welded)' but that is only true of ONE product in this catalogue - the Outpost Elite Cargo Bag, which is a genuine welded-seam shiny TPU dry bag. Every other product reviewed (both Outpost and Grid frame/top-tube/seat bags, the Local top-tube bag, trunk bag and both panniers) is a MATTE ripstop-textured nylon with visible bar-tacked stitching, not welded seams. Outpost-line bags carry Blackburn's signature safety-orange bar-tack stitching and red zip-pull tabs on black fabric; Grid-line bags are stealth black-on-black with a red interior lining and minimal branding; Local-line bags are plain matte black/grey with a reflective grey-outlined 'G' logo patch. Do not render the whole catalogue as shiny TPU.
brand_notes.dimensionEvidence: Nine of the sixteen products carry an official Blackburn dimensioned line-art diagram in their local photo set (frame bags x3, corner bag, both top-tube bags, both seat bags, the handlebar bag, the carryall/stem bag, the trunk bag, and both panniers - all except the two Grid SL/no-diagram products and the Local Saddle Bag). These are maker technical drawings, not estimates, and were used to correct the catalogue's prior `est:true` figures. Each correction was cross-checked against the stated capacity_l using the box/volume sanity rule in MODEL-SPEC step 3; in two cases (Outpost Frame Bag Medium and Large) the OLD catalogue figures produced a bounding box SMALLER than the stated capacity, which is physically impossible for a wedge that only partially fills its box, and confirms the old 'est' figures were wrong.
brand_notes.frameBagHeightConvention: Blackburn's own diagrams for the Outpost Frame Bag family (Small/Medium/Large) each carry TWO stacked height figures at the tall (head-tube) end rather than one, mirroring the FOUR-number pattern already resolved for the Outpost Corner Bag elsewhere in this catalogue. Following that precedent, the LARGER of the two figures was used as `hgt` (the true top-to-bottom extent of the wedge at its tall end); the smaller figure is a sub-measurement (likely to a seam/pocket line) and is recorded in dims_note only. This reading was validated by volume: at the larger-height reading the Small/Medium/Large boxes come out to 1.47x/1.67x/1.49x their stated capacity, consistent with a wedge that fills roughly two-thirds of its bounding box; the old estimated figures gave impossible sub-1.0x ratios for Medium and Large.
brand_notes.outpostSeatBagFamily: The local photo set for the Grid seat bags includes one composite Blackburn reference sheet (found under grid-large-seat-bag-Large-3.jpg) showing FOUR variants side by side - 'mtb', 'small', 'medium' and 'large' - but only Medium and Large exist as products in this catalogue. Flagging for awareness: a Grid MTB Seat Bag and a Grid Small Seat Bag appear to exist in Blackburn's lineup but are not present in data/brands.json, so they are out of scope here and were not added.
brand_notes.photoMismatch: The local photo folder for 'Local Saddle Bag' (local-saddle-bag-std-1..4.jpg) does NOT show a saddle bag. All four images are duplicates of the Local Rear Pannier's own photos (a large flap-over pannier pair, its dimensioned diagram at 355x355x125mm, and a rack-hook close-up) - almost certainly a scraping/asset-naming error upstream. A WebFetch of the maker page (bellhelmets.com/product/local-saddle-bag/...) returned no usable product copy either. As a result the Local Saddle Bag record below carries NO photographic or textual evidence and its dimensions are unchanged from the prior catalogue estimate - flagged rather than guessed, per MODEL-SPEC.
brand_notes.closureCorrections: Two products had a closure `type` in data/brands.json's features block that photographic evidence contradicts and which this record corrects: the Grid Handlebar Bag is a small zip-top 'gas tank' style pouch with a straight top zip, NOT a rolltop (there is no roll flap anywhere in the local photo set or the maker diagram); and the Local Rear Pannier closes with a top flap secured by a single side-release buckle strap (flap_buckle), NOT a rolltop.

products.name: Frame Bag

products.dims_note: len taken from the diagram's top-rail run (13.5in=34.3cm), replacing the catalogue's prior est. 40cm (which measured a longer diagonal/bottom edge, not the top-tube run this schema wants). hgt taken as the LARGER of the two stacked figures (9in=22.9cm) per the frameBagHeightConvention note - see brand_notes. wid (depth off the frame) is not shown in this side-elevation diagram and is carried unverified from the prior 6cm estimate. Volume check: 34.3x6x22.9=4714cc=4.71L against stated 3.2L, ratio 1.47 - a normal wedge ratio, and physically consistent (box larger than capacity).

products.name: Cargo Bag
products.dims_raw: 6.5 liters at 325mm (three rolls) x 150mm; welded waterproof roll-top, 420D nylon, flat 840D bottom, daisy-chain pass-through for cage straps.
products.dims_note: Already maker-verified and corrected by a prior pass (previously had a duplicated axis defect). Re-mapped here to MODEL-SPEC axis semantics: the 325mm figure is the bag's long axis, which mounts running roughly VERTICALLY alongside the fork leg (photos confirm), so it is recorded as hgt (top-to-bottom) rather than len; len/wid both carry the 150mm cross-sectional diameter. Blackburn's own figure is explicitly given 'at 325mm (3 rolls)', i.e. already the ready-to-ride rolled length, so no further render-block reduction is applied.

geometry.notes: Plain welded cylindrical dry bag, genuinely rigid-adjacent in the sense that the welded TPU/coated-nylon shell holds a firm cylindrical shape when rolled and buckled, but it is a SOFT dry bag, not a hard shell - it deforms readily when squeezed. Orange-stitched daisy-chain webbing ladder runs the length of the front face for the cargo-cage straps to pass through. Blackburn branding printed down the side.

closure.hardware: roll-top mouth pulled shut and clipped with a plastic side-release buckle at the carry handle

straps.material: orange-stitched webbing (supplied by the cargo cage, not sewn to the bag)

details.fabric: shiny welded TPU-laminate/coated nylon - the one genuinely TPU-laminate product in this catalogue (see brand_notes.materials)

mount.notes: Not self-mounting - it is a dry bag that straps INTO a separate rigid fork/frame cargo cage (Blackburn Outpost Elite cage or similar), which is not itself a product in this catalogue. Photos show it standing vertically against the fork leg, roll-top up, secured by two horizontal cage straps with orange-accented side-release buckles.
